title: 'It's Like a War.' Revisiting Dr. Fabiano Di Marco.

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金（Andrew Ross-Sorkin）。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼（Zilran Mondani）等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些全无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日于 nytimes.com 上对部分访谈进行现场直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔（Michael）。

sentences.en: For the rest of the week, we're revisiting people we met in the early weeks of the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 在本周剩下的时间里，我们将回访在疫情初期遇到的人们，

sentences.en: listening back, and hearing what's happened to them since our original conversations first ran.
sentences.zh: 重温当时的录音，并了解自我们最初的对话播出以来，他们身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: Today, Dr. Fabiano DiMarco of Bergamo, Italy.
sentences.zh: 今天的主角是意大利贝加莫的法比亚诺·迪马尔科（Fabiano DiMarco）医生。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 7 月 14 日，星期二。

sentences.en: Can you see me?
sentences.zh: 你能看见我吗？

sentences.en: No, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想不能。

sentences.en: I cannot see you, but I can hear you, and I think I can hear you.
sentences.zh: 我看不到你，但我能听到你，我想我也能听到你。

sentences.en: Oh, now I can see you.
sentences.zh: 哦，现在我能看到你了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Sorry for my English.
sentences.zh: 原谅我的英语。

sentences.en: I don't know if my English will be adequate for a podcast, but then you will decide, okay?
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的英语是否适合做播客，不过接下来由你来决定，好吗？

sentences.en: It's exceptional, and I'm really grateful that you're making time for us.
sentences.zh: 这非常棒，我非常感激你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 那么，你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: Now, I'm at home.
sentences.zh: 现在，我在家里。

sentences.en: After three weeks, today, in the afternoon, I'm at home because I have a big family with three children, and I decide to come back at home one day.
sentences.zh: 三周以来，今天下午我第一次在家，因为我有一个三个孩子的大家庭，我决定回家一天。

sentences.en: So, you have not been home in three weeks?
sentences.zh: 所以，你已经有三个星期没回过家了？

sentences.en: Three weeks, yes.
sentences.zh: 整整三个星期，是的。

sentences.en: I've been in my hospital every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在我的医院里。

sentences.en: It started the crisis Friday, the 21st of February, and since then, it was a total mess.
sentences.zh: 这场危机始于 2 月 21 日，星期五，从那以后，一切都陷入了彻底的混乱。

sentences.en: It's like a war.
sentences.zh: 这就像打仗一样。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: This is how Italy's cases have grown now for the last month, slowly at first, but now more rapidly.
sentences.zh: 这就是过去一个月里意大利确诊病例的增长情况，起初很慢，但现在越来越快。

sentences.en: It's a textbook epidemic curve.
sentences.zh: 这是一个教科书式的流行病曲线。

sentences.en: Italy has quickly become the new epicenter of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 意大利迅速成为大流行病的新震中。

sentences.en: With nearly 30,000 infections and more than 2,000 deaths, numbers that are soaring by the day,
sentences.zh: 近 3 万人感染，超过 2000 人死亡，而且数字还在与日俱增，

sentences.en: even after the government there took extreme measures to lock down much of the country.
sentences.zh: 尽管当地政府已经采取了极端措施，封锁了全国大部分地区。

sentences.en: We are at a critical inflection point in this country.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于这个国家的一个关键拐点。

sentences.en: On Monday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一，美国

sentences.en: Surgeon General warned that the United States is now on a strikingly similar path.
sentences.zh: 卫生局长警告称，美国目前正走上一条惊人相似的道路。

sentences.en: People, we are where Italy was two weeks ago in terms of our numbers, and we have a choice to make as a nation.
sentences.zh: 各位，就我们的数字而言，我们正处于两周前意大利所在的阶段，作为国家，我们面临着一个抉择。

sentences.en: Do we want to go the direction of South Korea and really be aggressive in lower our mortality rates, or do we want to go the direction of Italy?
sentences.zh: 我们是想走向韩国的方向，真正积极地降低死亡率，还是想走向意大利的方向？

sentences.en: Today, a conversation with a doctor in Bergamo, north of Milan, one of Italy's hardest-hit areas.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将与米兰以北意大利受疫情打击最严重的地区之一，贝加莫的一位医生进行对话。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, March 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 3 月 17 日，星期二。

sentences.en: Could I just ask you to just say your full name for me?
sentences.zh: 我能请你报一下你的全名吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: My name is Fabiano Di Marco.
sentences.zh: 我叫法比亚诺·迪马尔科（Fabiano Di Marco）。

sentences.en: I'm a professor of the University of Milan and the head of the respiratory unit of the hospital Papa Giovanni XXIII of Bergamo, which is a town close to Milan.
sentences.zh: 我是米兰大学教授，也是贝加莫若望二十三世医院（Papa Giovanni XXIII）呼吸科主任，贝加莫是靠近米兰的一个城镇。

sentences.en: Can you give me a sense and maybe paint the picture of what it's like in the hospital right now, what you're dealing with?
sentences.zh: 你能否向我描述一下，或者描绘一下目前医院里的情况，你们正在面对什么？

sentences.en: I have now.
sentences.zh: 我现在有了。

sentences.en: My world has been totally transformed.
sentences.zh: 我的世界已经彻底改变了。

sentences.en: Nothing is as before.
sentences.zh: 一切都今非昔比。

sentences.en: I have been in my hospital every single day and for 14 hours or 15 hours a day to try to deal with the outbreak of coronavirus infection.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在医院里，每天工作 14 到 15 个小时，试图应对冠状病毒感染的爆发。

sentences.en: What has been the story of what has happened in your hospital these past few weeks?
sentences.zh: 过去几周你们医院发生了什么？

sentences.en: Because I think people in the United States are desperate to understand what you have seen and what people have said to you and what it has looked like.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为美国的人们迫切想了解你所见到的情景、别人对你说的话以及当时的景象。

sentences.en: You described it as a war.
sentences.zh: 你把它形容为一场战争。

sentences.en: So we want to understand what you mean.
sentences.zh: 所以我们想了解你的意思。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Every day we receive, on average, between 50 to 70 patients with severe respiratory failure due to coronavirus infection every single day.
sentences.zh: 我们每天平均接收 50 到 70 名因冠状病毒感染导致严重呼吸衰竭的患者。

sentences.en: And to describe my reality, my hospital is, at least in Europe, a huge hospital with 1,000 beds.
sentences.zh: 要形容我的现实情况：我的医院，至少在欧洲，是一个拥有 1000 张床位的大型医院。

sentences.en: But to receive every day between 50 and 70 patients with severe pneumonia due to coronavirus, it's impossible.
sentences.zh: 但每天接收 50 到 70 名因冠状病毒导致严重肺炎的患者，这是不可能承受的。

sentences.en: You have to change your organization day by day.
sentences.zh: 你必须日复一日地改变你的组织架构。

sentences.en: And tell me what you mean.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我这是什么意思。

sentences.en: How do you have to change your organization to deal with people who are in such severe respiratory condition?
sentences.zh: 为了应对处于如此严重呼吸状况的病人，你们如何改变组织架构？

sentences.en: So we changed the normal ward, mainly surgery wards, because the activity of surgery has been reduced of at least 80%.
sentences.zh: 所以我们改变了普通病房，主要是外科病房，因为外科手术活动至少减少了 80%。

sentences.en: And we transformed, so far, five wards of surgery for patients with coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经将五个外科病房改造为收治冠状病毒患者的病房。

sentences.en: Now we have, between the five wards and the emergency room, at least 350 patients with respiratory failure due to coronavirus infection.
sentences.zh: 现在，在这五个病房和急诊室之间，我们至少有 350 名因冠状病毒感染导致呼吸衰竭的患者。

sentences.en: Today is the first day in which we have more than 50% of the hospital dedicated to coronavirus patients.
sentences.zh: 今天是第一天，我们医院有超过 50% 的床位专门用于收治冠状病毒患者。

sentences.en: To organize this, we had to teach cardiologists, dermatologists, rheumatologists, specialists of something very different from respiratory failure, how to treat this patient.
sentences.zh: 为了组织这一切，我们不得不教心脏病专家、皮肤科专家、风湿病专家——这些专长与呼吸衰竭截然不同的人——如何治疗这种病人。

sentences.en: You try to find a solution, but day by day, it's no longer enough.
sentences.zh: 你试图找到解决方案，但日复一日，这已经远远不够了。

sentences.en: So I can tell you that my colleagues, both physicians and nurses, they cry every day.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以告诉你，我的同事们，无论是医生还是护士，他们每天都在哭泣。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。
我 47 岁。

sentences.en: I'm not so, so old to be the head of a ward, at least in Italy.
sentences.zh: 作为一个病房的主任，我并不是非常非常老，至少在意大利是这样。

sentences.en: But I have with me 20 colleagues who are respiratory physicians, with many fellows.
sentences.zh: 但我手下有 20 位呼吸科医生同事，还有很多进修生。

sentences.en: They are 27, 30.
sentences.zh: 他们才 27、30 岁。

sentences.en: So for me, it's a huge responsibility.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这是一项巨大的责任。

sentences.en: And I was scared they can be sick, okay?
sentences.zh: 我很害怕他们会生病，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But we cry every day.
sentences.zh: 但我们每天都在哭。

sentences.en: And now we have, today, 460 nurses at home because they are sick.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们有 460 名护士因为生病在家。

sentences.en: And I think we have, yes, it's a very huge number.
sentences.zh: 我想我们有，是的，这是一个非常巨大的数字。

sentences.en: You have 460 nurses who are in a hospital in the middle of this crisis who are home because they're sick.
sentences.zh: 你们有 460 名正处于这场危机中心的医院护士，因为生病而待在家里的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 就在今天。

sentences.en: This is the outcome of today.
sentences.zh: 这是今天的结果。

sentences.en: And is that because they are sick with the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 是因为他们感染了冠状病毒吗？

sentences.en: There are some who are sick, some with a total burnout for the situation, and other who are contact of patients, so they stay in quarantine at home.
sentences.zh: 有些人是生病了，有些人是因为局势导致彻底的精神崩溃，还有些人是患者的密接者，所以他们在家里隔离。

sentences.en: Doctor, you said you are upset that you maybe even cry every day.
sentences.zh: 医生，你刚才说你很难过，甚至每天都在哭。

sentences.en: And I wonder if there is an experience, maybe one story or one patient, that made you upset.
sentences.zh: 我想知道是否有那么一段经历，也许是一个故事或一个病人，让你感到如此难过。

sentences.en: The main problem for us is to treat our colleagues.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，最主要的问题是治疗我们的同事。

sentences.en: As doctors, we are used to treat patients, and for us it's normal.
sentences.zh: 作为医生，我们习惯了治疗病人，对我们来说这很正常。

sentences.en: There is not so emotional, luckily, because we are used to treat other people.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，没有那么多情绪波动，因为我们习惯了治疗其他人。

sentences.en: But this is difficult when the patient is your colleague.
sentences.zh: 但当病人是你的同事时，这就很艰难了。

sentences.en: And we have now admitted tens of colleagues or nurse people who you will meet every day in your life.
sentences.zh: 我们现在已经收治了数十名你在日常生活中每天都会见到的同事或护士。

sentences.en: Your colleagues are now your patients, because they have contracted the virus.
sentences.zh: 你的同事现在成了你的病人，因为他们感染了病毒。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: For example, yesterday, the chief of my department come to the emergency room to be with a low level of oxygenation.
sentences.zh: 例如，昨天，我部门的主任来到急诊室，血氧水平很低。

sentences.en: He has a bilateral pneumonia due to coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 他患有由冠状病毒引起的双侧肺炎。

sentences.en: Wow, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 哇，我很遗憾。

sentences.en: Not very severe, but he was someone who tried to organize the hospital to deal with this infection three days ago.
sentences.zh: 病情不是很严重，但在三天前，他还是一个试图组织医院应对这场感染的人。

sentences.en: And we went to have a dinner with my wife and his wife one week ago.
sentences.zh: 就在一周前，我和我妻子还和他的妻子一起吃过晚饭。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: We are scared because on Friday, only in my hospital, we had 20 deaths.
sentences.zh: 我们很害怕，因为在周五，仅在我的医院里，我们就经历了 20 人死亡。

sentences.en: 20 deaths.
sentences.zh: 20 例死亡。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For coronavirus in one day.
sentences.zh: 一天之内因冠状病毒死亡。

sentences.en: That's extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, another important thing, we have not the opportunity to allow the relative to come to the hospital for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以，另一个重要的事情是，我们没有机会让家属来到医院，原因有二。

sentences.en: First, it's a danger for them and for other people, evidently, because in 80% of the cases, they are infected.
sentences.zh: 首先，显而易见，这对他 A 们和其他人来说都很危险，因为在 80% 的情况下，他们已经感染了。

sentences.en: The second reason, which is not easy to understand if you are not in this situation, is that we do not have enough personal protective equipment.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因，如果你没有身处这种境地是很难理解的，那就是我们没有足够的个人防护装备。

sentences.en: The mask in case of infection, something to cover the shoes and the gown.
sentences.zh: 感染时戴的口罩、鞋套和防护服。

sentences.en: It's impossible to find these now in Europe, not only in Italy.
sentences.zh: 现在不仅在意大利，在整个欧洲都根本找不到这些东西。

sentences.en: So, you're running out of those and you can't get them anywhere in the region or anywhere in Europe.
sentences.zh: 所以，你们的库存正在耗尽，你们在整个地区或整个欧洲都买不到。

sentences.en: You just can't get them.
sentences.zh: 你们就是买不到。

sentences.en: So, yeah, impossible to find.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，根本找不到。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: If I allow one or two relatives to come to the hospital, I have to give them these, but we do not have these for us.
sentences.zh: 如果我允许一两个家属来医院，我必须给他们这些装备，但我们连自己用的都不够。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You need them for doctors.
sentences.zh: 你们需要把它们留给医生。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They cannot receive the relative in hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们不能在医院接待亲属。

sentences.en: So, the patients are alone and they die alone.
sentences.zh: 所以，病人们孤零零的，孤零零地死去。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: We, this is difficult for us.
sentences.zh: 我们，这让我们很难受。

sentences.en: We try to call every day the relative.
sentences.zh: 我们尽量每天给家属打电话。

sentences.en: But I have to tell you that sometimes in the confusion of this new organization with a dermatologist who is trying to treat a patient with severe respiratory failure and probably the doctors cry and no one remembers to call the relative.
sentences.zh: 但我必须告诉你，有时在这种新组织架构的混乱中——一个皮肤科医生正试图治疗一个严重呼吸衰竭的病人，可能医生们都在哭泣，没有人记得去给家属打电话。

sentences.en: So, it's happened that the relative called the hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以，经常发生家属打来医院电话的情况。

sentences.en: And the person's already dead?
sentences.zh: 而这个人已经去世了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Doctor, you've mentioned a lot of the choices that you and your staff have to make now that this is such a terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 医生，你提到了你和你的员工在面对如此可怕的局面时不得不做出的许多选择。

sentences.en: And I wonder how you make decisions about who gets which treatment and who has the best chance to survive.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你们是如何决定谁接受哪种治疗、谁拥有最好的生存机会的？

sentences.en: How do you make those decisions?
sentences.zh: 你们是如何做出这些决定的？

sentences.en: This is, for us, a crucial point because we have hundreds of very sick patients, but we have tens of ICU beds.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这是一个关键点，因为我们有数百名重症患者，但只有几十张重症监护室（ICU）床位。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The problem is that you can find many scores of gravity, but these scores of gravity have been thought for another reason.
sentences.zh: 问题是你可以找到许多严重程度评分，但这些严重程度评分是出于其他原因而设计的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And when you say score of gravity, you mean basically kind of a calculation of who is in greatest need.
sentences.zh: 当你说严重程度评分时，你的意思是基本上对谁的需求最大进行某种计算。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So, for instance, if you are 80, you have a severe respiratory failure and, I don't know, you have also renal failure.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，如果你 80 岁，患有严重的呼吸衰竭，而且，我不知道，你还有肾衰竭。

sentences.en: I have to admit to you in the ICU because you are very severe and you have a probability to die very high.
sentences.zh: 我必须把你收进 ICU，因为你病情非常严重，死亡几率非常高。

sentences.en: Okay, I have to admit to you in the ICU, but now we need another score, which is a score which helps us to understand your probability to benefit of the ICU bed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我必须把你收入 ICU，但现在我们需要另一个评分，这个评分能帮我们了解你从 ICU 床位中获益的概率。

sentences.en: And we do not have this score.
sentences.zh: 而我们没有这个评分。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because it has not been created.
sentences.zh: 因为它根本还没被创造出来。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: We are trying to do this now because, for example, the age, for all this stage of severity, higher is the age, higher is the score.
sentences.zh: 我们现在之所以这么做，是因为比如在所有这些严重程度的阶段中，年龄越大，评分越高。

sentences.en: But when you have a few beds for many people, the age is absolutely the opposite.
sentences.zh: 但当病床很少而病人很多时，情况就完全相反了。

sentences.en: If you are 85, I give the bed to another one who is 45.
sentences.zh: 如果你85岁，我会把病床让给另一个45岁的人。

sentences.en: Because a 45-year-old is more likely to benefit from the ICU bed than the 80-year-old.
sentences.zh: 因为45岁的人比80岁的人更有可能从重症监护室的病床中受益。

sentences.en: So, you're saying all the normal rules have to be thrown out the window.
sentences.zh: 所以，你是说所有常规规则都必须抛出窗外了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全如此。

sentences.en: We need a new tool.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个新的工具。

sentences.en: We do not have, because so far, the difference between the number of patients and the number of beds is something totally new for us.
sentences.zh: 我们没有，因为到目前为止，病人数目和病床数目的差距对我们来说是完全崭新的情况。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And not only for us.
sentences.zh: 而且不只是对我们。

sentences.en: All the country will have to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 全国上下都必须面对这个问题。

sentences.en: But it's difficult to tell people that if you are 80, you will never have the ICU bed.
sentences.zh: 但很难告诉人们，如果你80岁，你就永远住不上重症监护室的病床。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But, so far, if you have not the opportunity to build a new hospital with 1,000 beds, such as in China, we need this terrible tool.
sentences.zh: 但是，到目前为止，如果你没有机会建造像中国那样拥有1000张床位的新医院，我们就需要这个可怕的工具。

sentences.en: Because this is a tool of selection.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个筛选工具。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Of who lives and who dies.
sentences.zh: 决定谁生谁死的工具。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And this is why it's important.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它很重要。

sentences.en: If you do not reduce the number of patients who are sick, it's impossible to deal with this disease.
sentences.zh: 如果你不减少生病的病人数目，就不可能应对这种疾病。

sentences.en: Impossible.
sentences.zh: 不可能。

sentences.en: You have to reduce the rate of infection.
sentences.zh: 你必须降低感染率。

sentences.en: And the only way to reduce the rate of infection is to change totally the life of people.
sentences.zh: 而降低感染率的唯一方法就是彻底改变人们的生活。

sentences.en: Now, in Italy, everyone is at home.
sentences.zh: 现在，在意大利，每个人都在家里。

sentences.en: This is a tragedy for economy.
sentences.zh: 这对经济来说是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: No one is working.
sentences.zh: 没有人工作。

sentences.en: No one is working.
sentences.zh: 没有人工作。

sentences.en: But it's the only way.
sentences.zh: 但这是唯一的办法。

sentences.en: There is not something in between.
sentences.zh: 没有中间路线可走。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying that once you are in a hospital as a doctor looking at a room full of people with this virus overwhelmed, it's too late.
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说，一旦你作为一名医生身处医院，看着满屋子感染这种病毒、不堪重负的病人，就已经太迟了。

sentences.en: That the role of countries who are not yet at the place Italy is in is to make sure they don't ever get to that place.
sentences.zh: 那些尚未达到意大利现状的国家，其作用就是确保他们永远不会走到那一步。

sentences.en: Don't ever get to the point that your hospital is at.
sentences.zh: 绝不要让你的医院走到那个地步。

sentences.en: And to do whatever it takes to not get there.
sentences.zh: 并不惜一切代价不去到那里。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You have two choices.
sentences.zh: 你有两个选择。

sentences.en: You decide to not close all the activities.
sentences.zh: 你决定不关闭所有活动。

sentences.en: Close the people in their home.
sentences.zh: 把人们关在家里。

sentences.en: And you will accept thousands of that.
sentences.zh: 然后你就要接受成千上万人的死亡。

sentences.en: Or you have to close all the activity.
sentences.zh: 或者你必须关闭所有活动。

sentences.en: There is not a choice in between.
sentences.zh: 没有介于两者之间的选择。

sentences.en: I know this is difficult to have this approach because also in Italy, if you speak with my colleague in another town, it's quite difficult to understand this.
sentences.zh: 我知道采取这种方法很困难，因为即使在意大利，如果你和另一个城镇的同事交谈，理解这一点也相当困难。

sentences.en: Because many people, including many physicians, have not the perception of this.
sentences.zh: 因为许多人，包括许多医生，都没有这种感知。

sentences.en: Because in your reality, all is normal.
sentences.zh: 因为在你们的现实中，一切都很正常。

sentences.en: It's difficult to be scared for something you have not the perception.
sentences.zh: 对你没有感知的事物感到害怕是很难的。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So, I can understand that in other countries, it's the same.
sentences.zh: 所以，我可以理解在其他国家也是如此。

sentences.en: But trust us.
sentences.zh: 但请相信我们。

sentences.en: Or, such as in Bergamo, each family will have a relative or a friend who dies.
sentences.zh: 否则，就像在贝加莫一样，每个家庭都会有一个亲戚或朋友死去。

sentences.en: This is a situation in Bergamo.
sentences.zh: 这就是贝加莫的现状。

sentences.en: This is not a disease that you can discuss on TV.
sentences.zh: 这不是一种你可以在电视上讨论的疾病。

sentences.en: You will have the perception of this in your family, in your relative, in your town.
sentences.zh: 你会在你的家庭、你的亲人、你的小镇中感受到这一点。

sentences.en: It's something very aggressive.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常具有攻击性的东西。

sentences.en: Very aggressive.
sentences.zh: 非常具有攻击性。

sentences.en: I wonder, as a doctor,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，作为一名医生，

sentences.en: what advice you would give to doctors in the United States who may have to do what you have to do and make the kind of difficult decisions that you have to make now.
sentences.zh: 你会给美国的医生什么建议？他们可能不得不做你不得不做的事，并做出你现在必须做的那种艰难决定。

sentences.en: I think that the best is to speak with us, to analyze the situation of Italy.
sentences.zh: 我认为最好是与我们交谈，分析意大利的情况。

sentences.en: It could be something important.
sentences.zh: 这可能是很重要的。

sentences.en: Because you have to be prepared for this.
sentences.zh: 因为你必须为此做好准备。

sentences.en: This is the only thing I would suggest to my colleague.
sentences.zh: 这是我唯一想对我的同事们的建议。

sentences.en: Because also in Italy, I have some colleagues in the other part of Italy who are not prepared.
sentences.zh: 因为在意大利，我在意大利其他地方的一些同事也没有做好准备。

sentences.en: And I speak with them.
sentences.zh: 我和他们交谈过。

sentences.en: They are doing the same thing we did three weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 他们正在做我们三周前做的事。

sentences.en: This is incredible.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: This new reality we are living started the 23rd of February, not three years ago.
sentences.zh: 我们正在经历的这种新现实始于2月23日，而不是三年前。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Three weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 三周前。

sentences.en: After three weeks, we are living in another dimension.
sentences.zh: 三周后，我们生活在另一个维度中。

sentences.en: For me, it's difficult to think to my life.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，回想以前的生活很难。

sentences.en: Before this, no one can be prepared for this.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，没有人能为此做好准备。

sentences.en: Impossible.
sentences.zh: 不可能。

sentences.en: I wonder, just a final question here.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，最后一个问题。

sentences.en: At the beginning of our conversation, you said you were finally home after three weeks.
sentences.zh: 在我们对话开始时，你说你三周后终于回家了。

sentences.en: And I wonder what it was like to come home to your family.
sentences.zh: 我想知道回到家人身边是什么感觉。

sentences.en: What are you telling them?
sentences.zh: 你对他们说了什么？

sentences.en: And how are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉如何？

sentences.en: My children are at home now for three weeks.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们已经在家里呆了三周了。

sentences.en: The schools are closed.
sentences.zh: 学校都停课了。

sentences.en: Luckily, there are three, so they can stay together.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是有三个孩子，所以他们可以作伴。

sentences.en: But we try to create a normal situation at home.
sentences.zh: 但我们试图在家里营造一种正常的生活状态。

sentences.en: For me, it's difficult because, evidently, I have a risk of infection which is higher than compared to other people.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这很难，因为显然，我感染的风险比其他人高。

sentences.en: So I had to decide what to do at home.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须决定在家时该怎么做。

sentences.en: If I stay with a mask, sorry, I decide to stay normal, without a mask.
sentences.zh: 如果我戴着口罩……抱歉，我决定保持正常，不戴口罩。

sentences.en: Sounds like this was a tough decision.
sentences.zh: 听起来这是一个艰难的决定。

sentences.en: Yeah, because I have to find a solution between to protect the best, my wife, and do not scare my children.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我必须找到一个解决方案，既能最大限度地保护我的妻子，又不会吓到我的孩子们。

sentences.en: The only good news is that children and young boys or girls are not affected.
sentences.zh: 唯一的好消息是儿童和年轻男孩女孩不受影响。

sentences.en: This is the only consolation for us.
sentences.zh: 这是我们唯一的安慰。

sentences.en: And I decided that I changed my approach to my children.
sentences.zh: 我决定改变我对孩子们的态度。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I pay attention to my hands.
sentences.zh: 我注意我的手。

sentences.en: I pay attention to my towel.
sentences.zh: 我注意我的毛巾。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But I decided to not wear a mask because it will be difficult for them to see the father, who is a respiratory physician in Bergamo, with a dozen of cases, hundreds of deaths.
sentences.zh: 但我决定不戴口罩，因为如果他们看到身为贝加莫呼吸科医生的父亲，面对着几十个病例、几百个死者还戴着口罩，对他们来说会很难接受。

sentences.en: So also for these, it's really difficult to decide what is the beSt.
sentences.zh: 所以即使对这些，也很难决定什么是最好的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I spoke with my wife, and we decided to do this.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子谈过，我们决定这样做。

sentences.en: It sounds like on top of all the difficult decisions you've had to make, you had to go home and make one more difficult decision, which was this mask.
sentences.zh: 听起来除了你不得不做所有艰难的决定之外，你回家后还要做一个更艰难的决定，那就是关于这个口罩。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: Doctor, I really want to thank you so much for giving us your time.
sentences.zh: 医生，我真的非常感谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: And I want to wish you the best of luck, you and all your colleagues, doctors and nurses at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我想祝你一切顺利，祝你和医院里的所有同事、医生和护士一切顺利。

sentences.en: So we're going to be thinking about you a lot in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 所以在接下来的日子里我们会常常想起你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It has been a privilege.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: I hope, indeed, to be useful for some of my colleagues and for you.
sentences.zh: 我也确实希望对我的某些同事和你们有所帮助。

sentences.en: The crisis in Bergamo has begun to subside.
sentences.zh: 贝加莫的危机已经开始消退。

sentences.en: Last week, Dr. DeMarco's hospital discharged its last ICU patient with severe symptoms of COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 上周，德马科医生的医院出院了最后一名患有严重2019冠状病毒病症状的重症监护室患者。

sentences.en: It was the first time that the unit had no cases in 137 days.
sentences.zh: 这是该病区137天来首次没有病例。

sentences.en: The staff there marked the milestone by observing a moment of silence for the hundreds of patients who have died from the virus,
sentences.zh: 那里的医护人员通过为数百名死于该病毒的患者默哀来纪念这一里程碑，

sentences.en: followed by a round of applause for those who had recovered from it.
sentences.zh: 随后为那些从中康复的人致以热烈的掌声。

sentences.en: Dr. DeMarco says he's encouraged by the region's progress, but on guard for a second wave of infections.
sentences.zh: 德马科医生表示，他对该地区取得的进展感到鼓舞，但也对第二波感染保持警惕。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, in recognition of his work, Italy's president awarded Dr. DeMarco the prestigious title of Cavaliere, making him a knight of the Italian Republic.
sentences.zh: 几周前，为表彰他的工作，意大利总统授予德马科医生“骑士”称号，使其成为意大利共和国的骑士。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to nerd a.
sentences.zh: 以下是你需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: I'll remind you, a week or so ago, I was reporting just six lives lost, and then a few days later, well, in excess of 100 lives loSt.
sentences.zh: 我提醒一下，大约一周前，我报道的丧生人数还只有6人，但几天后，丧生人数就远超100人了。

sentences.en: And so this continues to be a deadly disease.
sentences.zh: 所以这依然是一种致命的疾病。

sentences.en: On Monday, as infections soar, California announced a sweeping rollback of its plans to reopen,
sentences.zh: 周一，随着感染人数激增，加利福尼亚州宣布全面撤回其重新开放计划，

sentences.en: saying it would close indoor operations for restaurants, wineries, movie theaters and zoos, and shut down bars entirely.
sentences.zh: 称将关闭餐馆、酒庄、电影院和动物园的室内运营，并完全关闭酒吧。

sentences.en: One thing I just think is incredibly important to remind all of you is that this virus is not going away anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 我认为提醒大家极其重要的一点是，这种病毒短期内不会消失。

sentences.en: At the same time, two of the state's largest public school districts, Los Angeles and San Diego, said they would abandon plans to reopen in-person classes in the fall.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，该州最大的两个公立学区洛杉矶和圣迭戈表示，他们将放弃在秋季恢复实体课堂的计划。

sentences.en: And a new study has found that an estimated 5.4 million Americans lost their health insurance between February and May because of layoffs during the pandemic, a record figure.
sentences.zh: 一项新的研究发现，由于大流行期间的裁员，估计有540万美国人在2月至5月期间失去了医疗保险，创下历史纪录。

sentences.en: Nearly half of the insurance losses occurred in just five states,
sentences.zh: 近一半的保险损失发生在仅仅五个州，

sentences.en: Texas, Florida, New York, North Carolina, and California.
sentences.zh: 它们是得克萨斯州、佛罗里达州、纽约州、北卡罗来纳州和加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却最终失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
